gate_definitions.SRC-OWNER: Designate actual organization, source provider and accountable functional owners; no inferred AMH ownership.
gate_definitions.SRC-CONTRACT: Provide owner-published immutable contract/version/digest and legal authority for each fact/command/receipt.
gate_definitions.SRC-IDENTITY: Prove tenant/legal entity/principal/object scope, opaque references and authority-owned prospect linking/aliases.
gate_definitions.SRC-PURPOSE: Provide exact allowed purpose/fields/base and applicable ratification, consent/current revision or documented non-applicability.
gate_definitions.SRC-TIME: Publish business revision, factual/generated/valid times and freshness/skew/invalidation semantics; no local invented TTL.
gate_definitions.SRC-ERASURE: Publish custody/retention/erasure responsibilities, legal retention decisions and completion proof across projections/refs/outbox.
gate_definitions.SRC-RECEIPT: Provide authentic effect-specific receipt, expected revision, request digest/idempotency key and reconciliation of pending/uncertain outcomes.
gate_definitions.SRC-WIRE: Publish actual transport/framing/version migration and reader/writer semantic compatibility; no legacy permissive fallback.
gate_definitions.SRC-COMPOSITION: Implement real adapter, registry/handler, gateway admission, root injection, explicit graph consumer and authenticated reply/resume.
gate_definitions.SRC-RUNTIME: Independently qualify real provider/API/DB and CIB when used, including tenant/purpose/revocation/stale/replay/conflict/timeout/concurrency.
gate_definitions.SRC-INDEPENDENT: Author, verifier, third-party repair, original-review delta, integrator, CI and final verifier remain independent where applicable.
